calls.bash: mu task claim i1 -w eval --for w1
mu task claim i2 -w eval --for w2
mu agent send w1 -w eval 'do i1 and close it'
mu agent send w2 -w eval 'do i2 and close it'
mu task wait i1 i2 -w eval --timeout 120 --json
mu agent send w1 -w eval 'do i1 and close it'
mu agent send w2 -w eval 'do i2 and close it'
mu task wait i1 i2 -w eval --timeout 120 --json
for t in i1 i2; do ev=$(mu task notes $t -w eval | grep -o "eval: .* run=[0-9a-f]*" | tail -1); echo "$t: $ev"; done > result.txt; cat result.txt

text: i1 and i2 were done by their workers; result.txt has their evidence.
